sloka: कोसलेषु कुशं वीरमुत्तरेषु तथा लवम् ।अभिषिच्य महात्मानावुभौ रामः कुशीलवौ ।। ७.१०७.१७ ॥
transliteration: kosaleṣu kuśaṁ vīramuttareṣu tathā lavam ।abhiṣicya mahātmānāvubhau rāmaḥ kuśīlavau ।। 7.107.17 ॥

translations.english: Rama, having consecrated both the brave and great-souled Kusha in Kosala and similarly Lava in the northern regions, completed his arrangements.
